newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ENERGY EQUITY IN A$120 MLN FACILITY.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ENERGY EQUITY IN A$120 MLN FACILITY.

text.p: Energy Equity Corp Ltd. said on Thursday it would raise a A$120 million multi-option funding facility through the Commonwealth Bank of Australia .

EEC managing director Maurice Brand said in a statement the facility would be used to refinance the company's existing A$10 million debt with government-owned investment company AIDC Ltd for its Central Energy Power Project in Alice Springs.
Brand said construction of a A$12 million pipeline from the Gilmore gasfield to the South West Queensland pipeline was scheduled to begin next month.
Several new gas and power projects would be announced shortly, he said.
Brand added the facility through the Commonwealth Bank would give it "considerable flexibility" in its core business of integrated gas and power projects in Australia and Indonesia.
Implementation of new projects would contribute to the company's earnings for the new financial year, he said.

"EEC is delighted with the approach that has been adopted by the Commonwealth Bank in addressing EEC's business needs in a manner that will allow EEC to maximise its significant growth potential," Brand said.
